items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I couldn't tell you too much, about too many of the fellas in the band. I could call three guys I know of sure, four I'd say. Sam Morgan, Gaillet, playing trombone, Alfred William drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember the night, uh, he was, when he was awake with Sam Morgan's band. Uh-huh. Uh, he had a party of them, two men in St. Clair.

and he's playing a part of it and I don't know if the woman meant to cut him or cut somebody else taking him from someone else but then now he got cut right in the ear I know if you ever noticed that cut he got in his face I was staying right up there when the lady cut him when I saw that well I just being a kid you know I got excited I broke and run man I don't know what happened after that that's that kid how it started on drums yeah that's right that's what they tell me because when that happened I rang when…
